d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap aaj ghar me sabudane ke papad ka kaise banae uska recipe share kar raha hu, aap bhi banana, ekdam easy process hai aur jabardast bante hai
Ingredients:
1 Bowl Sabudana
2 Bowl Pani (soaking ke lie)
4 Bowl Pani - (boiling ke lie)
Masala mein:
Namak - 1/2 tsp
Mircha / Chilli Flakes - 1 tsp
